module: Stores, for each vehicle of a race scenario, the last waypoint reached (position, direction, up vector, waypoint indices). Used to put back at the last checkpoint the AI-driven vehicles that are stuck: every 4 s, a non-playable vehicle that has left its starting point (> 1 m) and has not moved more than 4 cm since the last sample is put back at the last checkpoint. Active only if the scenario is in the 'running' state and enableCheckpoints is true with more than one element in lapConfig.
notes: M.state.vehicleCheckpoints[vehId] contains: vehicleName, checkTimer, pos, dirVec, upVec, currentWpName, currentWpIndex, nextWpIndex, initialPos, prevVehPos, raceOver. M.state.aiVehiclePath[vehId] keeps the argument of the AI's scenariohelper.setAiPath (the waypoints list loses each waypoint reached).
Only vehicles that are playerUsable or controlled by the scenario's AI (scenario.aiControlledVehiclesById) are initialized (when the vehicle is created and when the scenario restarts).

The reset to checkpoint is done by a local function ResetToSavedCheckpoint: resetBrokenFlexMesh, setPositionRotation, then a GE callback via queueGameEngineLua to completeReset, and recovery.clear() on the vehicle side.
Inconsistency: completeReset indexes M.state.vehicleCheckpoints[vehicleId] without checking that it exists (Lua error if the vehicle has no checkpoint).
Serialized in onSerialize/onDeserialized (keys converted id <-> vehicle name); the campaign save only records vehicleCheckpoints.

state.desc: Internal state: vehicleCheckpoints (table<integer, table>) and aiVehiclePath (table<integer, table>), reset at level start/end.

saveCheckpoint.desc: Records a restart point for a vehicle and resets its timer to 0. Without cpData, uses the vehicle's current position and direction; the up vector is always the vehicle's. Does nothing (log) if the vehicle does not exist.

saveAIPath.desc: Stores the AI path (argument of setAiPath) of the vehicle designated by its name, to restore it when put back at the checkpoint.

vehicleName.desc: name of the vehicle object in scenetree

arg.desc: table passed to scenario/scenariohelper.setAiPath (waypoints field = names)

completeReset.desc: Called back (round trip vehicle -> GE) after the replacement: reapplies the saved AI path and informs scenario_waypoints of the checkpoint's waypoint indices.

onRaceWaypointReached.desc: Hook: a vehicle reaches a race waypoint. Records the checkpoint (waypoint position; direction = the waypoint's curRot, otherwise the vehicle's velocity vector) and marks raceOver at the last waypoint.

data.desc: vehicleId, vehicleName, curPos, curRot (optional), waypointName, cur, next

onPreRender.desc: Per-frame hook: detects stationary AI vehicles (see module description) and puts them back at the last checkpoint.

onScenarioRestarted.desc: Hook: resets the data then initializes a checkpoint for each vehicle of the scenario.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook: initializes the checkpoint of a new vehicle if it has none.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: removes the destroyed vehicle's checkpoint.

onClientPreStartMission.desc: Hook: before a level loads, resets the data.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: on leaving the level, resets the data.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: returns vehicleCheckpoints and aiVehiclePath with keys converted to vehicle names (extension reload).

onDeserialized.desc: Hook: restores the serialized state (vehicle names converted back to ids).
